conf.description: Linux syslog auth (authpriv) / JSON rsyslog template: Extract JSON envelope, map typed rsyslog properties to ECS (timestamp, host, facility/severity, process, message), guard '-' placeholders on procid/msgid. Body (sshd/sudo/pam) grok stays with the deferred Elastic logs-system.auth pipeline per the map's own notes.

conf.comment: linux-syslog / auth / json. rsyslog's authJSON template puts an RFC3339 timestamp, typed facility/severity, and the RFC5424 app-name/msgid on the wire, removing the yearless-header and missing-host.ip guesswork the syslog-raw feed needs. The msg body is still unparsed sshd/sudo/pam text -- that grok stays with logs-system.auth downstream, so this pipeline only reshapes the envelope.

functions.description: record scope: envelope reshape only, body grok deferred to Elastic
extract the rsyslog JSON template envelope from _raw into top-level fields
compute derived/awkward-source fields from the ORIGINAL vendor names before the batched rename below (hyphenated fromhost-ip/app-name need bracket access; procid/msgid need '-' guards)
batch rename every clean 1:1 mapped field
tag event.dataset and drop consumed source fields (glob removal for the hyphenated fromhost-ip/app-name; _raw dropped since event.original already holds the pre-parse copy)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
